verdict.rationale: Yapily says its platform can "confirm account ownership and customer details instantly," and its Data API returns "account details" for consumer, business and corporate accounts via a consent-based accounts endpoint. That supports matching an account owner to a customer, but no evidence shows exactly which holder fields come back. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of returned account-holder names, addresses and contact data (e.g., an identity endpoint schema), field coverage across banks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
